description: Registry of cognitive skills (competencies, rules, and evidence criteria) available for PM.ai and ENG.ai Masters during reasoning and planning.

velocity_analysis_skill.competence: Computes historical and current sprint completion rates, volatility metrics, commitment-vs-delivered ratios, and predicts trajectory risks for ongoing sprints.
evaluation_criteria: Minimum 3 historical sprints analyzed for rolling average
Volatility standard deviation computed
Variance between committed and completed story points identified

visual_trigger.description: Generates a dual-axis burndown chart displaying committed points vs completed points across sprints with trend forecasting.

defect_correlation_skill.competence: Correlates reported defects with system requirements, impacted test cases, historical bug trends, and delivery milestones to determine severity, urgency, and probable leakage direction.
evaluation_criteria: Defect severity and reproduction state verified
At least one requirement node linked in the graph
Probable leakage direction classified (Requirements, Design, Code, or Test)

visual_trigger.description: Visual diagram showing defect origin, propagation through development phases, and milestone blast radius.

root_cause_discovery_skill.competence: Pinpoints deterministic code-level root cause by analyzing AST syntax, git commit diffs, regression points, and runtime execution traces under failing test conditions.
evaluation_criteria: Regression-introducing commit identified with hash and author
Exact file, function, and line-level boundary condition isolated
Deterministic reproduction validated with failing test execution

visual_trigger.description: Annotated code diff highlighting unstable logic boundary alongside call stack sequence.

test_coverage_analysis_skill.competence: Measures requirement-to-test traceability gaps, edge-case test omissions, branch coverage deficits, and identifies missing regression tests for boundary conditions.
evaluation_criteria: Requirement coverage percentage calculated against active backlog
Missing test cases for critical thresholds documented
Specific test case IDs mapped to failing assertion conditions

visual_trigger.description: Requirement-to-test coverage heatmap showing green/red test verification density across modules.

code_quality_vulnerability_skill.competence: Analyzes source code for architectural anti-patterns, complexity hotspots, boundary instability (e.g., hysteresis omission), security flaws, and compliance standards.
evaluation_criteria: Syntactic validity of candidate patch verified
Complexity metrics remain within thresholds post-patch
Zero new security vulnerabilities introduced

visual_trigger.description: Radar chart comparing before/after cyclomatic complexity, test coverage, and security score.

resource_capacity_skill.competence: Evaluates engineer utilization, team skill affinities, vacation/calendar constraints, and workload imbalances to produce feasible sprint and PI allocations.
evaluation_criteria: Individual engineer allocation not exceeding 85% planned capacity
Competency match verified for assigned technical tasks
Absence/leave calendars factored into available hours

visual_trigger.description: Stacked bar chart showing engineer capacity vs committed story hours across sprints.

dependency_risk_skill.competence: Traverses the Neo4j Knowledge Graph to calculate ripple effects, upstream blocking requirements, downstream architectural dependencies, and delivery milestone blast radius.
evaluation_criteria: Transitive closure of impacted dependencies calculated up to depth 3
Critical path milestones identified and flagged if threatened
Cross-component ripple blast radius scored (Low/Medium/High/Critical)

visual_trigger.description: Force-directed dependency network showing defect/requirement node and affected ripple nodes.

sprint_timeline_skill.competence: Forecasts sprint completion schedules, models critical path timelines, simulates scope adjustments, and calculates schedule variance under varying velocity conditions.
evaluation_criteria: Projected completion date computed with 80% confidence interval
Critical path variance measured in business days
Scope reduction trade-offs ranked by milestone preservation impact

visual_trigger.description: Visual Gantt timeline highlighting critical path tasks, float time, and milestone delivery date.

eight_d_problem_solving_skill.competence: Executes the rigorous Eight Disciplines (8D) methodology to systematically isolate root causes, deploy containment actions, prove permanent corrective actions (PCA), and prevent systemic recurrence.
evaluation_criteria: All 8 discipline sections completed with verifiable evidence envelopes
Direct link established between D4 root cause and D5 corrective patch
Passing regression test proving D6 verification before resolution

visual_trigger.description: Ishikawa Fishbone root cause diagram with D1-D8 status badges.

five_why_analysis_skill.competence: Executes recursive 5-Why causal questioning drilldown, verifying each causal link with code, test, or process evidence to expose foundational systemic breakdowns.
evaluation_criteria: Each 'Why' transition supported by at least one verifiable evidence envelope
Transition from immediate technical symptom to underlying systemic root cause verified
Countermeasure proposed for Why-4 and Why-5

visual_trigger.description: Stepped ladder causal diagram mapping Why 1 through 5 with linked evidence citations.
